lines.trans: That was how I unexpectedly completed my very first show proposal.
This time it was not for an ideal, but for a person.
If the old Bu Xiaogu knew, she would surely tease the person I am today.
Today we have the honour of welcoming fan-club president Mr Xu Tianze; welcome!

words.gram: Meaning: have the good fortune/honour to.

lines.trans: The person I look up to is just like a distant ideal.
Whenever I step closer to him, the path underfoot is full of thorns.
Again and again, he shatters my illusions.
Yet again and again, he lets me see his truer face.
Only much later did I realise that once I forgot my former self.
I had already stepped into his world of production.
